fields.account:
Improve mobile UX: auto-grow textarea, safe areas, touch targets, font hierarchy

- Replace single-line input with auto-growing textarea (Enter sends, Shift+Enter newlines)
- Add viewport-fit=cover + env(safe-area-inset-*) padding for iPhone notch/home bar
- Fix iOS Safari auto-zoom by enforcing 16px font-size on inputs in mobile breakpoint
- Use 100dvh to handle virtual keyboard layout changes
- Set min-height: 44px on buttons for comfortable touch targets
- Switch message text (.msg) to system sans-serif for a friendlier reading experience
  while keeping monospace for nicks, timestamps, and chrome
- Add enterkeyhint="send", autocorrect, autocapitalize, spellcheck to textarea
- Add align-items: flex-end to say-form so button stays bottom-aligned as textarea grows
